notes: Singular in Hindi (unlike English 'glasses'): one pair is 'एक चश्मा'.
covers both prescription glasses and sunglasses (often called धूप का चश्मा).
To say 'wear/put on glasses', use 'चश्मा लगाना' or 'चश्मा पहनना'.
